gemini.summary: Fast-paced retro-modern sports explainer combining archival VHS/CRT footage with punchy mixed-media paper cutouts, vector stadium infographics, and bold Arabic display typography. The palette is dominated by sports turf greens (kelly green, deep forest, neon lime) set against high-contrast black-and-white photography, paper whites, and warm vintage broadcast tones. Motion is snappy and impactful, driven by overshoot scale pops, kinetic title slams, and smooth camera zoom punches synced to dynamic swooshes, impacts, and referee whistle sound effects. Fast-paced documentary motion graphics combining retro VHS archive footage, tactical 2D pitch diagrams, and high-contrast paper-cutout collages. The palette consists of pitch green (#1DB954), monochrome black-and-white, cream paper accents, and bold white typography. Kinetic Arabic type syncs with spoken narration alongside graphic doodles and film textures. High-contrast editorial sports collage aesthetic mixing acid green (#98FF00 / #00A843), stark black-and-white halftones, and textured paper document elements. Bold modern geometric Arabic typography drives kinetic subtitle emphasis with animated highlighter accents. Animation features snappy mechanical cutouts, multi-panel split screens, frame-by-frame highlighter rotoscoping, and dimensional typography. Pacing is fast and punchy, synced tightly to voiceover beats. Tactical sports explainer utilizing mixed-media collage, vintage CRT archive footage, and minimalist motion graphic diagrams. The palette relies on pitch-green, charcoal black, off-white, and referee high-visibility yellow and red. Modern geometric Arabic typography is paired with kinetic data callouts and clean vector icons. Motion alternates between energetic paper-cutout transitions and smooth vector zooms. Fast-paced graphic outro bumper utilizing flat 2D vector shapes, sports pitch line work, and signature lime green accents. Bold Arabic typography anchors the center frame before rapidly scaling out. Dynamic physics-driven motion blur trails and punchy zooms create an energetic conclusion. Subtle CRT barrel distortion vignette frames the vertical canvas.

signature_moves: CRT & VHS Archive Framing: Archival broadcast footage is framed inside curved black pillbox borders mimicking vintage television screens, accompanied by scanlines, timecode overlays, and analog tape distortion.

Halftone Collage Aesthetic: Archival player photographs and body parts are extracted as crisp black-and-white cutouts with halftone dot textures, accented by bold solid neon green contour silhouettes.
Selective Color Highlighting: Black and white imagery highlights critical story elements in punchy color, such as yellow penalty cards, golden trophies, or neon balls.
Kinetic Typography Cascade: Key narrative verbs and titles (like 'إمساكها' or 'تشتيتها') are stacked vertically or animated with punchy overshoots, contrasting solid white and electric green.
Top-Down Vector Stadium Transitions: Stylized flat vector stadium diagrams and 3D props (e.g. referee whistle) serve as thematic title cards with dramatic camera plunge zooms.
Pointer Indicator Overlays: Tactical green triangle markers and glowing pitch lines track and isolate specific subjects within historical archival stills.
CRT curved screen container with subtle scanline overlay and chromatic aberration wrapping all archival scenes.
B&W stipple/halftone photo cutouts bordered with thick torn paper/sticker outlines.
Tactical board top-down diagrams utilizing fluorescent green/yellow balls with multi-frame echo dot trails.
Kinetic typography stacking vertically in duplicates with progressive opacity/color tints.
Hand-drawn marker doodle arrows and circle highlights accentuating key anatomical rules.
Dithered halftone cutout figures framed by thick off-white/yellow paper cut stroke outlines.
Acid lime-green (#98FF00) solid backdrops contrasting with high-contrast monochrome imagery.
Dynamic word-by-word kinetic typography with pop-in highlighter boxes and staggered line reveals.
Photocopy collage aesthetic utilizing newspaper grids, archive documents, and mechanical sports props (stopwatches, whistles).
Animated neon marker rotoscope doodles (12fps) drawn over photographic cutouts.
Pill/rounded vertical card masking transitioning between scenes.
CRT television vignette border containing archived broadcast footage.
Cutout collages framed with torn paper edges and vibrant solid backdrops.
Technical football pitch line art layered with typography and mechanical objects.
Trailing motion echoes behind moving circle markers (ball position tracers).
Analog stopwatch graphics combined with oversized numerical typography.
CRT barrel curved framing vignette across vertical formats.
Trailing echo dots/ghosting to signify fast sports motion.
Rapid punch zoom into solid color transitions on segment ends.

audio.mix: Authoritative Arabic male narration occupies the upfront vocal frequency, while background rhythmic percussion and subtle suspense pads drive pacing. Sound effects (kicks, catches, referee whistles, CRT hums, paper rustles, heavy bass drops) are tightly synchronized with on-screen visual hits. | Authoritative Arabic male narration sitting clearly in the center foreground, light ducking applied to low-key synth percussion, and sharp, physical Foley hits synchronized with graphic reveals. | Upfront conversational Arabic male voiceover dominating mid-frequencies; snappy foley (clicks, marker strokes, whistle, clock ticks) ducking subtle driving electronic background bed. | Professional voiceover dominates center channel; energetic documentary score ducks beneath narration; crisp foley (stopwatch ticks, impacts, whooshes) punctuates key graphical transitions. | Clean sonic riser and impact sting; narrator voice concludes before sting.
audio.music: Driving, mid-tempo documentary electronic beat featuring subtle sub-bass pulses, minimal synths, and crisp rhythmic hi-hats that create tension without overshadowing voiceover. | Minimalist modern documentary beat featuring subtle synth pads, muted sub-bass pulses, and rhythmic percussion. | Muted low-tempo electronic beat with sub-bass pulses and minimalist percussion maintaining tension. | Rhythmic, modern electronic-ambient hybrid with driving bassline and steady percussion. | High-energy electronic percussive sting cadence resolving video.
